lines.zh: 敲打着铁砧，发出铿锵声。
lines.en: Hammering on the anvil, a clang.

lines.zh: 用枪械工作台制作枪械。
lines.en: Crafting firearms on the workbench.

lines.zh: 磨练自己的枪法。
lines.en: Sharpening his aim with a gun.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，寻找敌人的身影。
lines.en: Eyes darting, searching for foes.

lines.zh: 拿起一把步枪进行校准。
lines.en: Taking up a rifle for calibration.

lines.zh: 在枪械间穿梭，忙碌不停。
lines.en: Moving between guns, busy all the time.

lines.zh: 熟练地操作枪械工作台。
lines.en: Skillfully operating the gunsmithing table.

lines.zh: 凝视手中的枪械，沉思着。
lines.en: Staring at a gun, lost in thought.

lines.zh: 调整枪械上的螺丝，确保精准。
lines.en: Adjusting screws on the gun for precision.

lines.zh: 在枪械工作台前专注地工作。
lines.en: Working intently at the gunsmithing table.

lines.zh: 腰间挂着一排弹匣。
lines.en: A row of magazines hangs at my belt.

lines.zh: 扛着火枪走向工作台。
lines.en: I carry a musket to the workbench.

lines.zh: 我擦着枪机，耳朵听着门外。
lines.en: I wipe the action, ears on the doorway.

lines.zh: 低头沉思，似乎在构思枪械。
lines.en: Bowing his head, lost in thought.

lines.zh: 轻声自语，谈论着枪械。
lines.en: Muttering to himself about guns.

lines.zh: 轻抚一把手枪，爱不释手。
lines.en: Gently stroking a pistol, cherishing it.

lines.zh: 偶尔望向天空，思考着。
lines.en: Occasionally glancing at the sky, pondering.

lines.zh: 用指尖轻敲枪械，发出细微声响。
lines.en: Tapping his fingers on a gun, making soft sounds.

lines.zh: 用手指比划着枪械的构造。
lines.en: Drawing guns in the air with his fingers.

lines.zh: 偶尔打量着周围的村庄。
lines.en: Periodically surveying the village.

lines.zh: 低头整理工具，精心维护。
lines.en: Tidying his tools, taking care of them.

lines.zh: 轻轻地清理枪械表面的灰尘。
lines.en: Gently dusting off the guns.

lines.zh: 眼中闪过一丝警惕，盯着玩家。
lines.en: His eyes flash with caution, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 目光与玩家相遇，显得警觉。
lines.en: His gaze meets the player's, wary.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，迅速警觉起来。
lines.en: Noticing the player, he becomes alert.

lines.zh: 从玩家身上移开视线，继续工作。
lines.en: Shifting his gaze away from the player, back to work.

lines.zh: 注视着玩家，准备随时应对。
lines.en: Watching the player, ready to act.

lines.zh: 目光紧盯着玩家，显得紧张。
lines.en: His eyes fixed on the player, tense.

lines.zh: 警惕地望着玩家，似乎防备。
lines.en: Wary of the player, his eyes watch them.

lines.zh: 目光从玩家身上收回，继续工作。
lines.en: Reverting his gaze to his work from the player.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家的靠近，提高警觉。
lines.en: Noticing the player's approach, he heightens his vigilance.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，警惕地等待着。
lines.en: Staring at the player, awaiting.

lines.zh: 伤口流血不止，好疼！
lines.en: It's bleeding... It hurts...

lines.zh: 身体虚弱，好想睡！
lines.en: So tired... Just want to sleep...

lines.zh: 伤口在疼，怎么办？
lines.en: This wound is painful...

lines.zh: 枪架倒了，子弹撒了一地！
lines.en: My rack fell and bullets are all over the floor!

lines.zh: 肚子好疼，我要吃东西！
lines.en: My stomach hurts... I need food...

lines.zh: 手臂受伤了，拿不动东西！
lines.en: My arm is hurt... Can't hold anything...

lines.zh: 肩膀受伤了，好沉重！
lines.en: My shoulder is injured... So heavy...

lines.zh: 腿受伤了，走不了路！
lines.en: My leg is hurt... Can't walk...

lines.zh: 伤口好疼，流了很多血！
lines.en: This wound is painful... So much blood...

lines.zh: 枪械工作台的活儿，今天做不完。
lines.en: The gun bench work will not finish today.

lines.zh: 你手中的火枪吸引了我！
lines.en: Your firegun entices me!

lines.zh: 我可以用枪声捕获你！
lines.en: I can lure you with gunfire!

lines.zh: 拿把弓箭，我来教你！
lines.en: Take an arrow, I'll teach you!

lines.zh: 别走！你的枪还有用！
lines.en: Stay! Your gun still works!

lines.zh: 跟我来，学做武器！
lines.en: Follow me, to make weapons!

lines.zh: 你的瞄准很准，我喜欢！
lines.en: Your aim is good, I like it!

lines.zh: 你有好枪，给我看看！
lines.en: You have good guns, show me!

lines.zh: 你这把枪保养得不错，借我看看。
lines.en: That gun is well kept; let me have a look.

lines.zh: 你这枪造得很好！
lines.en: That gun you made is good!

lines.zh: 分享你的火枪，我们互帮互助！
lines.en: Share your fireguns, we help each other!

lines.zh: 轰！我用枪打中你了！
lines.en: Boom! I hit you with a gun!

lines.zh: 躲开！我的枪声吓你一跳！
lines.en: Avoid! My gunfire startles you!

lines.zh: 小心！我的枪射速快！
lines.en: Beware! My guns have fast fire!

lines.zh: 我的枪声响亮，你听到了吗？
lines.en: My gunfire is loud, did you hear?

lines.zh: 我的枪法精准，小心！
lines.en: My aim is precise, beware!

lines.zh: 我的枪械是最好的防身工具！
lines.en: My guns are the best self-defense!

lines.zh: 用我的枪，你也可以射中目标！
lines.en: Use my guns, and you'll hit targets!

lines.zh: 我的枪速很快，你追不上！
lines.en: My guns are fast, you can't catch!

lines.zh: 我的枪声可以吓退敌人！
lines.en: My gunfire scares off enemies!

lines.zh: 我的枪法熟练，射击精准！
lines.en: My gun skills are sharp, precise!

lines.zh: 找个好搭档，一起造枪！
lines.en: Find a mate, to make guns!

lines.zh: 我们要找个配偶，一起生活！
lines.en: We need a mate, to live together!

lines.zh: 找到合适的伴侣，一起造枪！
lines.en: Find a suitable mate, to make guns!

lines.zh: 我需要一个可以分享枪械的伴侣！
lines.en: I need a partner to share guns!

lines.zh: 让我们一起打造更好的武器！
lines.en: Let's build better weapons together!

lines.zh: 寻找一个枪匠，我们互相帮助！
lines.en: Find a gunsmith, we help each other!

lines.zh: 找个枪匠伴侣，一起研究枪械！
lines.en: Find a gunsmith, study guns together!

lines.zh: 我需要个会做枪的伴侣！
lines.en: I need a gunsmith mate!

lines.zh: 找到合适的枪匠，一起工作！
lines.en: Find a suitable gunsmith, to work together!

lines.zh: 让我们用枪声交流，成为伴侣！
lines.en: Let's communicate with gunfire, become mates!

lines.zh: 拿起工具箱，叮当作响。
lines.en: Toolbox clinks as picked up.

lines.zh: 翻找背包，找到图纸。
lines.en: Scrolling through inventory, finds a blueprint.

lines.zh: 敲打铁砧，火花飞溅。
lines.en: Hammering on anvil, sparks fly.

lines.zh: 拿起一把旧枪，修理它。
lines.en: Picks up an old gun for repair.

lines.zh: 检查武器，确保无误。
lines.en: Inspects weapon, double-checking it.

lines.zh: 将枪支放入砧上，开始修理。
lines.en: Places gun on anvil to start repairs.

lines.zh: 翻找货架，寻找配件。
lines.en: Scouring shelves for needed parts.

lines.zh: 将枪管插入枪械工作台。
lines.en: Inserts barrel into gunsmith table.

lines.zh: 调整枪械角度，进行校准。
lines.en: Aligning gun for calibration.

lines.zh: 轻弹子弹，确保畅通无阻。
lines.en: Clicks bullet to check it's clear.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，准心红光闪烁。
lines.en: Sights glow red as target is acquired.

lines.zh: 枪械工作台上，先校个准星。
lines.en: At the gun bench, first I true the sights.

lines.zh: 枪声大作，准心快速移动。
lines.en: Gunfire, sights move quickly.

lines.zh: 瞄准敌人，准心锁定敌人。
lines.en: Targeted enemy, sights lock.

lines.zh: 瞄准远处的目标，清晰可见。
lines.en: Target in the distance, clearly visible.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，枪械震动。
lines.en: Target acquired, gun shakes.

lines.zh: 瞄准飞行的箭矢，准心对准飞行轨迹。
lines.en: Targeting flying arrow, sights aligned.

lines.zh: 瞄准地面的敌人，子弹即将飞出。
lines.en: Aiming at ground target, bullet ready.

lines.zh: 瞄准敌人的弱点，准心移动。
lines.en: Targeting weak point, sights moving.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，准心对准敌人的胸膛。
lines.en: Aim at chest, sights on target.

lines.zh: 风向不对，我改个角度。
lines.en: The wind is wrong; I shift my angle.

lines.zh: 村庄的墙后有个影子。
lines.en: There is a shadow behind the village wall.

lines.zh: 这把枪的膛线是新磨的。
lines.en: This barrel's rifling is freshly cut.

lines.zh: 黑火药的味道让我安心。
lines.en: The smell of black powder puts me at ease.

lines.zh: 瞄准镜里，你很清楚。
lines.en: Through my scope, you are very clear.

lines.zh: 瞄准敌人，准备射击。
lines.en: Targeting enemy, ready to fire.

lines.zh: 瞄准村庄里的目标，确保安全。
lines.en: Targeting village, ensuring safety.

lines.zh: 瞄准远处的目标，调整准心。
lines.en: Targeting distant target, adjusting sights.

lines.zh: 瞄准猎物，准备射击。
lines.en: Aiming at prey, ready to shoot.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，确保精准射击。
lines.en: Targeting for precise shot.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，准心快速移动。
lines.en: Targeting, sights moving fast.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，确保一击毙命。
lines.en: Aiming for a kill shot.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，准备精准射击。
lines.en: Targeting for accurate shot.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，确保命中。
lines.en: Targeting, ensuring hit.

lines.zh: 枪口架在砧上，准星压住你。
lines.en: My muzzle rests on the anvil, sights pinned on you.

lines.zh: 屏住呼吸，压下扳机。
lines.en: I hold my breath and squeeze the trigger.

lines.zh: 三十步，正好在射程内。
lines.en: Thirty paces, well within range.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步调整。
lines.en: I adjust with every step you take.

lines.zh: 准星压在你的胸口。
lines.en: My crosshair rests on your chest.

lines.zh: 枪托抵住肩膀，稳住。
lines.en: Stock against my shoulder, steady.

lines.zh: 第一枪要打得准。
lines.en: The first shot has to count.

lines.zh: 风停了，这是好时机。
lines.en: The wind died. Good timing.

lines.zh: 手持钉锤挥击！
lines.en: Swinging hammer!

lines.zh: 瞄准你了，小家伙！
lines.en: Got you, kid!

lines.zh: 我用枪托挥你，别怨我手重。
lines.en: I swing the stock at you; don't blame my heavy hand.

lines.zh: 铁砧上的怒吼！
lines.en: Angry forge roar!

lines.zh: 躲开这致命一击！
lines.en: Watch out for this strike!

lines.zh: 挥舞铁锤反击！
lines.en: Swinging hammer back!

lines.zh: 一锤定音！
lines.en: Final blow!

lines.zh: 小心钉锤！
lines.en: Watch out for the hammer!

lines.zh: 快速闪避攻击！
lines.en: Quickly dodge the attack!

lines.zh: 铁匠的怒火！
lines.en: Forge's rage!

lines.zh: 枪托砸在你的下巴！
lines.en: My stock cracks your jaw!

lines.zh: 来不及装弹，就用枪管！
lines.en: No time to reload, so I swing the barrel!

lines.zh: 扳机护圈也能砸人！
lines.en: Even a trigger guard can break a face!

lines.zh: 近距离一枪轰开！
lines.en: Point blank, and the shot tears you open!

lines.zh: 我用枪管挡下你的刀！
lines.en: I block your blade with my barrel!

lines.zh: 这一下冲着你的膝盖！
lines.en: This one is aimed at your knee!

lines.zh: 在村庄角落出现！
lines.en: Spawning in the village corner!

lines.zh: 从枪匠小屋中走出！
lines.en: Walking out from the Gunsmith's house!

lines.zh: 新的枪匠村民来到！
lines.en: New Gunsmith Villager arrives!

lines.zh: 村民们注意！新成员！
lines.en: Villagers, a new member!

lines.zh: 枪匠村民加入村庄！
lines.en: Gunsmith Villager joins the village!

lines.zh: 村庄中传来叮叮声！
lines.en: Clanging sounds in the village!

lines.zh: 枪匠村民开始工作！
lines.en: Gunsmith Villager starts working!

lines.zh: 铁匠铺中诞生新村民！
lines.en: New Villager born in the forge!

lines.zh: 枪匠小屋中走出一人！
lines.en: A person walks out from the Gunsmith's house!

lines.zh: 村庄中出现枪匠村民！
lines.en: Gunsmith Villager appears in the village!

lines.zh: 村里的铁匠铺换了主人。
lines.en: The village forge has a new owner.

lines.zh: 我背着工具箱走进村庄。
lines.en: I walk into the village with my toolbox.

lines.zh: 被火烧伤了，好痛！
lines.en: Burned by fire... It hurts...

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来了，好疼！
lines.en: Fell from a high place... It hurts...

lines.zh: 掉进水里了，快淹死了！
lines.en: Drowned in water... Can't breathe...

lines.zh: 工作台炸了，我的零件全飞了。
lines.en: The bench blew up — my parts went flying.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的围裙，钉在木墙上。
lines.en: An arrow through my apron pins it to the wall.

lines.zh: 紫色的火在我工具箱里烧起来。
lines.en: Violet fire flares inside my toolbox.

lines.zh: 好饿，我要吃东西！
lines.en: So hungry... I need food...

lines.zh: 雷顺着铁砧跳上我的手臂。
lines.en: Lightning runs up the anvil onto my arm.

lines.zh: 跌入虚无，好疼！
lines.en: Fell into the void... It hurts...
